title: アマガミ
sources: yomikata scan 0.2.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 914,233 characters of prose-like text
The harness: the prologue played to its first pages, and the strings of dialogue in memory there (some 22,000) gone through for what isn't text
notes: Lines are plain Shift-JIS with the engine's own marks among them, in ASCII: cleanup takes them out. ／ breaks a line. R<word>R<n> and n characters after it are a reading over the word. Nn and Nm stand for the player's given and family names: cleanup puts the names the game offers (純一, 橘), which is wrong after a rename. V<n> names a voice clip, W<n> and Wv<n> wait; E, F, m, b, a, P, S, L with letters and digits turn the portrait's eyes, face, mouth and pose; B, As, Ts, Ti, Mc, Ev were seen and not looked into.
